template.name: sequentia/capped-sale

params.label: Token sold, the coin's own asset
params.name: TOKEN

params.label: Asset a purchase is paid in
params.name: PAY_ASSET

params.label: Price: atoms of the payment asset per PRICE_DEN atoms of the token
params.name: PRICE_NUM

params.label: Atoms of the token the price is quoted for
params.name: PRICE_DEN

params.label: SHA256 of the scriptPubKey that receives every payment
params.name: TREASURY

params.label: Least a purchase buys and least a remainder holds, in the token
params.name: MIN_LOT

params.label: Close: a block height below 500,000,000, or a unix time at or above it, after which the project reclaims
params.name: CLOSE

params.label: Project key, which reclaims what is left after the close
params.name: PROJECT_KEY

paths.effect: Buys AMOUNT of TOKEN, at least MIN_LOT, for a buyer on the allocation list, who shows their leaf (key, cap, amount bought) and its 16-level proof against ALLOCATIONS and signs the whole transaction with that key (BUYER_SIG, BIP340 over sig_all_hash). The amount bought plus AMOUNT may not exceed the cap. The coin must hold TOKEN explicitly. With the coin at input k, output 2k pays TREASURY at least ceil(AMOUNT x PRICE_NUM / PRICE_DEN) of PAY_ASSET explicitly, and unless AMOUNT is the whole coin, output 2k+1 re-creates the sale with exactly the rest, at least MIN_LOT, in the state whose tree differs only in this buyer's amount bought, raised by AMOUNT.
paths.name: purchase
paths.who: a buyer on the allocation list

paths.effect: Spends the coin into any transaction PROJECT_KEY signs once CLOSE has passed: an absolute lock (OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY), a height or a time as CLOSE is one. The close does not stop purchases; until the project reclaims, a buyer within their cap can still buy.
paths.name: reclaim

slots.label: Root of the allocation tree: each buyer's key, cap and amount bought
slots.name: ALLOCATIONS

template.summary: Sells a token at a fixed price to the buyers on an allocation list, each up to their cap, with every buyer's running total carried in the coin's state; the project takes what is left after the close.

purchase.transaction: the sale at input 0, the buyer's payment coin and a fee coin in a third asset; the payment, the rest, the buyer's tokens, the payment change, the fee change and the fee

purchase_at_input_1.transaction: the same with the sale at input 1, so the payment at output 2 and the rest at output 3

full_buy.transaction: a purchase of the whole coin: no rest, output 1 the payment change

reclaim.transaction: the reclaim leaf spending one coin after the close, a fee coin; the coin's value, the fee change and the fee
